title: IPC payload
description: Application payload carried in an IPC frame: unpadded base64url bytes and an optional media type. One shape for the directed send, the broadcast publish and the broadcast delivery event, asserting the 49,152-byte payload ceiling (ADR-0026) as 65,536 encoded characters; the direct delivery event (`endpoints:message-received`, an `approved` schema outside `ipc`) carries the same bounds inline.

media_type.description: 1..128 ASCII bytes when present. Empty is INVALID rather than an alias for absence — the content fingerprint distinguishes the two.

bytes.description: Unpadded base64url; the pattern asserts alphabet and terminal lengths because contentEncoding constrains nothing in Draft 2020-12.
